description: WinDivert runtime artifact policy for etwarden.

artifacts.name: WinDivert.dll
artifacts.doc: WinDivert user-mode DLL. Must be bundled next to etwarden.exe in Windows release packages.

artifacts.name: WinDivert32.sys
artifacts.doc: WinDivert 32-bit kernel driver. Not packaged for x64 releases.

artifacts.name: WinDivert64.sys
artifacts.doc: WinDivert 64-bit kernel driver. Must be bundled next to etwarden.exe in Windows x64 release packages; official signed binaries preferred.

releasePackage.licenseMode: Convey WinDivert under LGPLv3 terms; keep dynamic DLL loading and ship license/notice.

policy: Repo root runtime artifacts are gitignored. Windows release packages must bundle WinDivert.dll and WinDivert64.sys with WinDivert license/notice via scripts/package-release.ps1.
